title: Portugal: meet the DJ priest evangelising through electronic music
summary: Priest by day, DJ by night: that's the life of Guilherme Peixoto, a Portuguese priest who has become a global icon. A fan of electronic music, he rose to fame after DJ'ing at the Church's World Youth Day in 2023, in front of 1.5 million people - but not everyone agrees with his approach. #portugal #dj #catholicism
